name: organiseur-personnel
description: PWA personnelle iPhone, socle technique S5

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build --base=/organiseur-personnel/ && npm run build:sw && node -e "require('node:fs').copyFileSync('manifest.webmanifest','dist/manifest.webmanifest')"
scripts.test:core: tsc --ignoreConfig --strict --target ES2022 --module commonjs --lib ES2022,ESNext.Temporal,DOM,DOM.Iterable --outDir .tmp-tests tests/domain.test.ts tests/activities.test.ts tests/navigation.test.ts tests/monthlyReview.test.ts tests/storage.test.ts tests/googleCalendar.test.ts && node -e "require('node:fs').writeFileSync('.tmp-tests/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'commonjs'}))" && node --test .tmp-tests/tests/*.test.js
scripts.build:sw: tsc --ignoreConfig --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --lib ES2022,DOM --skipLibCheck --rootDir src --outDir dist src/pwa/service-worker.ts && node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); const worker = 'dist/pwa/service-worker.js'; const assets = fs.readdirSync('dist/assets').filter(name => /[.](js|css)$/.test(name)).map(name => 'assets/' + name); const source = fs.readFileSync(worker, 'utf8'); const marker = 'const buildAssets = [];'; if (!source.includes(marker) || !assets.length) throw Error('Ressources PWA manquantes'); fs.writeFileSync('dist/service-worker.js', source.replace(marker, 'const buildAssets = ' + JSON.stringify(assets) + ';')); fs.unlinkSync(worker);"
